notes: Old cast street plate (raised letters, tilted) and a separate house-number plate '302' on a crumbling wall in Santiago de Cuba; dark, low-contrast photo. The street plate shows only 'PADRE P' (calle Padre Pico per the source). Small 'dani2010 copyright ©' credit bottom right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: DnTrotaMundos ☮
attribution: Photo: DnTrotaMundos ☮, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sancti_Sp%C3%ADritus_(Cuba)--La_Casa_de_la_Trova_street_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Carved wooden guitar-shaped sign of the Casa de la Trova in Sancti Spíritus, hanging in a blue doorway. The initial C of 'Casa' is formed by the guitar-body outline, so the letters read 'asa de la trova'. Small 'dani2010 copyright ©' credit bottom right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sancti Spíritus (Cuba)--La Casa de la Trova street sign.jpg

author: Jan Pešula
attribution: Photo: Jan Pešula, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Havana_street_sign_Marino_Tulipan.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Stone corner marker (guardacantón) on a Havana sidewalk with stencilled street names on its faces: MARINO on the front, TULIPAN (no accent painted) on the right face; the I's are stencilled with a dot. A third face in shadow at left repeats a name rotated and is not reliably legible. Seen from above. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Keith Ruffles
attribution: Photo: Keith Ruffles, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Havana,_Cuba_-_panoramio_(43).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small dark-framed street plate 'AGUIAR' with an octagonal house-number plate '152' below, on a corner building in Old Havana; plates are small in frame. Distractors: faded painted sign at right ('CAFE ALMA', 'COMIDA Y BEBIDAS', with an arched top line that looks like 'PRECIOS ECONOMICOS' but is not clearly legible), faint ghost lettering left of the door, 'RON' roundel, and a vegetable cart with people. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Joe Ross from Lansing, Michigan
attribution: Photo: Joe Ross from Lansing, Michigan, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Airport_sign,_Cienfuegos,_Cuba._(11805417135).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large painted plank billboard at Cienfuegos airport with a drawing of the terminal; GONZALEZ painted without accent. Palm fronds touch the final S of CIENFUEGOS. Bust on a plinth in front. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Joe Ross from Lansing, Michigan
attribution: Photo: Joe Ross from Lansing, Michigan, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_for_the_Villa_Lagarto_restaurant,_Cienfuegos,_Cuba_(11808570316).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: SIGA LA FLECHA Y ENCONTRARÁ EL PARAISO

notes: Illuminated paladar sign at night in Cienfuegos with a green iguana, red arrow header and LED 'OPEN' sign below. The small script 'Tony y Maylin' is hard to read (the second name could be 'Maylín'), and the arrow text is small. Faint 'LOS DELFINES HOSTAL' sign at right is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign for the Villa Lagarto restaurant, Cienfuegos, Cuba (11808570316).jpg

notes: Municipal welcome monument on a roundabout in Boyeros, Havana: red letters BOYEROS on a beam above a model aircraft, with SALUDA in red letters behind it. Shot from a moving vehicle through glass. Oro Negro petrol station canopy and a blue keep-left sign are distractors.
